title: Customer Information Management System
subtitle: Enterprise Record Administration & Multi-Role Data Governance
overview: A production-grade customer record management system built with Java enterprise technologies, featuring secure session management, role-based access control, and normalized relational storage.
problem: Enterprises struggle with fragmented customer data across decentralized spreadsheets, resulting in data duplication, lack of audit trails, and security vulnerabilities during client data retrieval and updates.
solution: Architected a multi-tier web application utilizing JSP and Java Servlets with connection-pooled JDBC querying MySQL. Implemented strict server-side validation, SQL injection prevention through PreparedStatements, and a responsive administrative dashboard.
keyFeatures: ACID-compliant CRUD operational workflows for enterprise customer entities
Dynamic search, multi-column sorting, and server-side pagination for high record counts
Robust authentication layer with encrypted session persistence and CSRF token verification
Relational integrity enforcement with cascade safety and foreign key mapping in MySQL
Exportable customer audit reports and activity logs for operational compliance
architecture: MVC Architecture: View (JSP/Tailwind-style modern views) -> Controller (Java Servlets & Request Dispatchers) -> Model (DAO Pattern, Connection Pooling, MySQL RDBMS)

title: Online Library Management & Circulation Engine
subtitle: High-Throughput Inventory & Automated Circulation Control
overview: High-performance Core Java and JDBC-driven inventory tracking system engineered to automate book issuance, catalog classification, and automated overdue penalty calculations.
problem: Manual library workflows experience significant circulation latency, recurring book misallocations, and human error in tracking multi-tiered overdue penalties.
solution: Engineered an object-oriented Java backend applying clean modular layers (DTO/DAO), indexed MySQL schemas, and parameterized queries that guarantee zero data collisions during simultaneous member transactions.
keyFeatures: Optimized catalog lookup algorithms supporting title, author, ISBN, and genre filters
Automated transaction workflows for book borrowing, renewal, and checked-in returns
Rule engine for real-time penalty calculations based on dynamic due-date differential algorithms
Secure administrative controls with partitioned privileges for librarians and library members
Optimized JDBC connection management with resilient exception logging and connection reuse
architecture: Layered Enterprise Architecture: Presentation UI -> Service Business Logic Layer -> Data Access Object (DAO) Layer -> Database Connection Pool -> MySQL DB

title: IoT Remote Computer Room Energy Platform
subtitle: Published Telemetry System for Telecom Infrastructure (IJNIET)
overview: Peer-reviewed IoT energy monitoring and load management platform built to optimize power consumption across telecom operators' remote computer rooms using MQTT telemetry.
problem: Unmonitored telecom computing hubs incur massive energy overheads and thermal spikes due to continuous HVAC operations without real-time environmental telemetry.
solution: Engineered an end-to-end monitoring and automation pipeline connecting IoT sensor nodes over lightweight MQTT protocol to a Blynk cloud infrastructure, featuring automated threshold alerts and load actuation.
keyFeatures: Continuous telemetry acquisition of current, voltage, temperature, and ambient humidity
MQTT-based lightweight publish-subscribe messaging minimizing bandwidth across remote links
Automated threshold-triggered load shedding to prevent thermal overload and power surges
Cloud telemetry dashboard with historical trend graphs and real-time anomalous power spikes
Published as a peer-reviewed research paper in the International Journal of New Innovations in Engineering and Technology (IJNIET)
architecture: IoT Telemetry Stack: Edge Sensor Array -> Microcontroller Firmware -> MQTT Broker / Blynk Cloud -> Java Backend Services -> Web Analytics Dashboard

title: Scalable E-Commerce REST API & Microservice Engine
subtitle: Spring Boot, JWT Security & Relational Data Orchestration
overview: High-throughput backend service providing enterprise RESTful endpoints for catalog filtering, authenticated shopping cart state, order workflows, and role-based administration.
problem: Modern commerce platforms demand stateless, horizontally scalable API endpoints capable of processing concurrent checkout requests while maintaining transactional consistency.
solution: Built a Spring Boot REST API utilizing Spring Security with stateless JWT authorization, Spring Data JPA / Hibernate for relational persistence, and clean layered domain-driven design.
keyFeatures: Stateless JWT authentication with refresh token rotation and granular role authorizations
Comprehensive CRUD RESTful endpoints with input validation via Bean Validation (JSR 380)
Transactional order checkout flow guarded by ACID database constraints and stock reservation locks
Structured error handling with centralized ControllerAdvice and RFC 7807 problem details
Complete Postman API documentation collections with automated test assertions
architecture: Spring Boot Layered Microservice: Client Request -> Security Filter Chain (JWT) -> RestController -> DTO Mapping -> Business Service -> JPA Repository -> MySQL

title: Smart Civic Cleanliness & Waste Monitoring System
subtitle: IoT Volumetric Depth Telemetry & Dynamic Dispatch Logistics
overview: Smart municipal sanitation management system leveraging ultrasonic sensors, microcontrollers, and real-time alert dispatch to optimize civic waste collection routes.
problem: Unscheduled waste collection causes civic bin overflow, environmental contamination, and inefficient municipal vehicle dispatch routes.
solution: Designed a sensor telemetry system that continuously calculates bin fill levels, evaluates threshold percentages, and fires automated notification webhooks to municipal dispatchers.
keyFeatures: Ultrasonic volumetric depth sensing measuring real-time capacity in municipal containers
Dynamic threshold detection triggering real-time SMS and dashboard collection alerts
Interactive municipal status portal color-coding bin capacity statuses (Normal / Warning / Critical)
Battery-efficient sleep cycles enabling prolonged standalone telemetry operation
Data logging capabilities allowing municipal planning teams to analyze peak waste cycles
architecture: Edge Hardware -> Telemetry Gateway -> Backend Alert Webhooks -> Real-Time Supervisor UI Dashboard

title: Automated License Plate Recognition (ALPR) System
subtitle: Computer Vision Pipeline with ROI Localization & Character Segmentation
overview: Computer vision pipeline engineered to accurately localize license plates and segment alphanumeric characters from vehicle imagery under varying lighting conditions.
problem: Manual gate clearance and vehicle entry logging cause traffic bottlenecks and are prone to human transcription errors in high-density facilities.
solution: Engineered an image processing pipeline applying adaptive grayscale thresholding, morphological ROI bounding box filtering, and character segmentation.
keyFeatures: Robust contrast adjustment and 2D median filtering to mitigate ambient lighting irregularities
Edge detection and mathematical morphology to detect rectangular plate regions of interest (ROI)
Connected-component labeling for precise individual alphanumeric character isolation
Presented and demonstrated at the National Level Technical Symposium at Excel Engineering College
Modular algorithm structure designed for easy integration with backend access control databases
architecture: Raw Image Input -> Pre-processing & Filtering -> Edge Detection & Morphology -> ROI Bounding Box Extraction -> Character Segmentation & Output
